title: 日本ダービーの後に・誉

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Shining splendidly in first place is none other than Narita Brian! This is her second crown following her victory in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The crowd is going wild! And Narita Brian, the new Derby Champion, raises her fist in the air in reply!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (If I shut my eyes, I can still see the that final stretch. Everyone straining, fighting for the finish line.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (I feel like I'm still there, still running… More. I want more…)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Brian! Brian! Brian! Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Thanks. But the next race is the Kikuka Sho, where only the strongest racer can win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is a long-distance 3,000-meter turf race. It's the final race in the Classic Triple Crown tour and requires both speed and stamina to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The battle for the finish line continues. An even more exciting race awaits…

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Brian! Congratulations on your second crown!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: We can't wait to see you follow in Symboli Rudolf's footsteps and become the next Triple Crown Champion!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: I'll take care of them as usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown Champion following Rudolf, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Ridiculous! Who's following anyone?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Goals aren't to be chased after, they're to be exceeded!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the concert, I take Narita Brian back to the academy, where…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Amazon?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I won the Japanese Oaks and you won the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh… So you have two tiaras now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And I'm getting ready to take you down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh? So when are we going to face each other?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha, don't get ahead of yourself. The Arima Kinen is where it's gonna go down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's where we'll see who's the best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And if one of us doesn't get our three trophies?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Does it matter? You're always goin' on about how you're not interested in titles.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want to talk about what comes after the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the major year-end event—a 2,500-meter turf race in Nakayama, where top-tier runners earn their reputation.
choice_data_list: You'd be competing with senior-year racers.
You'd be competing with senior-year racers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So the Kikuka Sho determines who's the strongest in their generation, and the Arima Kinen determines who's the strongest of all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah… Sounds great. Going for the top is what being an Umamusume's all about!
